description: Negative controls for the KeyCortex parsed-command autonomy fail-closed correction. Each restores one defect in key-cortex-query-pipeline.service.ts and names the tests that must then fail. Run with scripts/proof-admission/negative-controls.mjs; the proof is a unit suite and needs no database.

controls.claim: The executable parsed-command set starts empty, so an authority check that throws leaves nothing executable. Restoring the historical initialization from parsedCommands makes every parsed command executable again on error.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 an autonomy evaluation that throws leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 a failure on a later command does not keep the approved prefix
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 a genome autonomy check that throws leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P03 the conversational response completes with no effect when the authority check fails
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P06 the evidence and the log name a failed authority check as failed closed

controls.claim: The batch is atomic: commands approved before a failing evaluation are not kept. Publishing each approval as it is made keeps the approved prefix executable.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01 a failure on a later command does not keep the approved prefix
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P06 the evidence and the log name a failed authority check as failed closed

controls.claim: A verdict that does not state a boolean allowed, a boolean requiresApproval and a recognized tier is a failed authority check. Without that check a truthy non-boolean is read as an approval, an allowed with no approval semantics is read as an approval, and a verdict with no allowed is read as an ordinary denial that keeps the rest of the batch.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B a verdict whose allowed is truthy but not a boolean leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an unusable verdict (an object without allowed) leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with no approval or tier metadata leaves zero parsed commands executable

controls.claim: STEP_5_CHECK_AUTONOMY names a failed authority check as authority_check_failed_closed. Reporting it with the outcome of an ordinary evaluation hides the failure behind zero approvals.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P06 the evidence and the log name a failed authority check as failed closed
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B a verdict whose allowed is truthy but not a boolean leaves zero parsed commands executable

controls.claim: AUTH-FC-F1. allowed: true is not an approval unless the verdict also states requiresApproval and a recognized tier. Restoring the validator of 65706fcc, which checked only a boolean allowed, lets a verdict with the approval semantics left out be read as an explicit non-approval-required allow, and the command executes.

mutation.find:
typeof allowed === 'boolean' &&
      typeof requiresApproval === 'boolean' &&
      (tier === 'manual' || tier === 'supervised' || tier === 'full')

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with no approval or tier metadata leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with no requiresApproval leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with no tier leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with an unrecognized tier leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with a non-boolean requiresApproval leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B a genome autonomy verdict of allowed with no approval or tier metadata leaves zero parsed commands executable

controls.claim: AUTH-FC-F1. requiresApproval must be stated as a boolean. Without that check a verdict that omits it, or carries a falsy non-boolean, is read as no approval required.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with no requiresApproval leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with a non-boolean requiresApproval leaves zero parsed commands executable

controls.claim: AUTH-FC-F1. tier must be one of manual, supervised or full. Without that check a verdict with no tier, or with a tier this code does not know, is read as not manual.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with no tier leaves zero parsed commands executable
KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P01B an allowed verdict with an unrecognized tier leaves zero parsed commands executable

controls.claim: With no authority oracle the local fallback is a complete, ordinary non-executable verdict. If it does not state its tier the stricter validator rejects it and the absence of an oracle is reported as authority_check_failed_closed instead of an ordinary evaluation.

unit: KeyCortexQueryPipelineService parsed-command autonomy fails closed AUTH-FC-P05 no authority oracle stays non-executable and is not reported as a failure
